title: 006 生死局
content_zh:
寻常人大都只能驾驭一柄兵器，双刀双剑已是极少，因为其中的平衡感甚难掌握，稍不留神就会露出极大的破绽，而天女蕊竟能同时使用三把刀！
唐莲皱眉道：“三刀舞最大的特点就是它近乎霸道的进攻，当三把刀同时出现的时候，那么它的进攻将不会停下，只能是不死不休！”
两名剑客此时心中已是骇然，只能急退，却见天女蕊左手挥动手中短刀，用力击了那把犹在空中的短刀，右手一转，身形是一个优雅的旋转，裙角飞舞，像是水面上的涟漪一般好看。空中的那柄短刃疾速地像金袍商人袭去，黑剑客举剑欲挡，却感觉到短刃上的力量似乎竟有千钧之势，手被剧烈地一震，手中之剑脱手而出。
“这……这……”金袍商人惊骇地喊了出来。
白剑客急忙挡在了金袍商人的面前，用力一挥手中之剑，将短刃击飞到了空中。
而天女蕊此时已一跃而起，她将左手之刃收回了袖中，然后一把握住了那柄短刀，急落而下，冲着商人袭去。白剑客冷笑一声，刺出了手中之剑。
天女蕊微微一笑，身形在空中一转，放慢了下落之势，足尖在白剑客的剑刃上轻轻一点，借着他的剑势再度一跃而起，稳稳地落在了金袍商人的后面，手中之刃抵在了他的后背上。
“这……”金袍商人吓得浑身都是冷汗，一下子跪倒在了地上，“不知在下做错了何事，竟让天女动怒至此！在下……在下……”
“好啦。”天女蕊收起了手中之刃，走上前，在那个满头是汗的油脸上轻轻拍了两下，安慰道，“我也就是吓吓你，不会真的杀你。至于为什么吓你，也只是让在场的人知道。”
“这位公子的赌局不单是金钱局了，他赌的东西可要比这两箱明珠要贵重得多了。”天女蕊转身，冲着在场的其他商人朗声道。
众人相视一眼，吸了一口冷气：“生死局。”
“没错，就是生死局。”天女蕊浅笑。
萧瑟皱了皱眉，问唐莲：“什么是生死局。”
唐莲想了想：“大概就是输的人不仅要把钱留下，也要把命留下。”
萧瑟脸色顿时煞白：“我什么时候说我要这么赌了。”
天女蕊此时已经走了回来，笑吟吟地看着唐莲：“莲，我能帮你的也只有这些了，经过这番后，大概有人会知道美人庄对你的这笔货也有兴趣。那么一大半人会从三顾城里退出去，但是有些人我可搞不定。”
陆续有商人带着侍从离场了，只有寥寥几人仍留在场中，萧瑟望了一眼，心中顿时升起一股绝望感：“呵……他们倒也来了。”
只见不远处，一个身形魁梧的巨汉，手中提着一把大的就像是门板一样的刀，整个人站着那里就像是一座山一样。而另一个身形曼妙的姑娘，正坐在他身边的一张桌子上，晃着修长的双腿，冲他们微微一笑，手中轻轻一挥，袖中一张金贴已冲着他们飞来。
天女蕊脸色一变，那帖子竟然冲着她直飞而来的，她足尖轻轻一尖，轻跃而起将那张金贴一脚又踢了回去。月姬双指将名帖一夹，若有所思地看着她。
天女蕊笑道：“月姬笑送帖，冥侯怒杀人。你们的帖子我可不接，接了可得死。你要杀的是他们，我跟他们可没关系，姑娘别误会了。”

“你！”萧瑟怒道，扭头望向唐莲，却见唐莲根本没有注意这边，他顺着唐莲的目光看过去，却见一个中年文士打扮的人坐在那里，约莫三十多岁的年纪，却已是满头白发。他的面前放着一把剑，那柄剑出奇的精致，竟像是一整块美玉打造的一般，闪耀着流动的光芒。
中年文士微笑颔首：“又见面了。”
“你也是冲着那件事物来的？”唐莲问道。
中年文士却不回答，只是点了点头，说道：“你的伤已经好了。两日前我初见你时，你的伤还很重。”
“那当然，我的蓬莱丹可是帝都药王殿才有的灵药，即便你带着这一筐明珠去，也得看药王殿的心情才卖不卖你。这点伤，我的药还是糟蹋了。”萧瑟得意地说道。
中年文士转头看向他，微微皱了皱眉头，片刻之后笑道：“想不到唐公子身边还有这样一位高人。”
天女蕊此时忽然想起了什么，恍然道：“这些天，虽然涌入三顾城的人很多，但是离奇消失的也很多。莫非……”
中年文士点点头：“为了不给唐公子增加不必要的麻烦，多余的人已经帮唐公子除掉了。”
“说得好听，不过是一句‘先把和我抢的人杀了，再来和你抢’。”萧瑟不屑道。
中年文士愣了一下，随即一笑：“也是这个道理。”
“那是雪月城的东西，抢雪月城的东西，阁下真的做好决定了。”唐莲问道。
中年文士摇摇头：“看来你并不知道里面的究竟是什么东西，那并不属于雪月城。只不过你们动作比较快，先拿到罢了。”
“看来你知道里面是什么东西？”唐莲问道。
中年文士长笑一声后正色道：“是魔物！”
“阁下或许弄错了。”萧瑟突然说道，“现在这美人庄内最重要的事乃是在下的赌局，如果阁下对我的赌局没兴趣，那么就请移步吧。”
“赌局？”
“生死局。”
天女蕊盈盈一笑：“对啊，在美人庄内，生死局可是难得一见的。来这里的人都腰缠万贯，能过人世间最奢华的生活，又怎么会参与这种亡命之徒才参与的赌局呢。”
“我是个剑客。”中年文士抚摸着摆在他面前的那把美玉一般的剑，“掌握我生死的只有剑，而不是几个骰子。不过今晚我倒愿意陪二位玩这个游戏，如果二位赢了我，那么我就再给两位一夜的时间去逃。”
“一夜的时间去逃？”萧瑟淡淡一笑，“你太自信了。”

“自不自信赌过就知道了。”中年文士右手一挥，远处红木桌子上的骰蛊已经整个地向他飞了过去，稳稳地落在了他的手上。
“隔空取物？”唐莲微微皱了皱眉。
“江湖术士拿来变戏法的功夫你也用。”萧瑟倒是一脸不屑，自顾自搬了条凳子慢悠悠地拖到了桌子前坐了下来，回头看了一眼唐莲，发现他仍在发呆，只能无奈地用力拍了拍凳子。
“怎么？”唐莲不解，问他。
萧瑟无奈道：“过来坐啊，你们雪月城的人，脑子里除了打打杀杀，就没别的了么。”
“哦哦哦。”唐莲急忙跑了过来。
中年文士手轻轻摇晃着骰蛊，说道：“一局定输赢吧。你们赢，我走。我赢，东西留下，你们也可以走。”
“听着倒很公平，至少不管输赢，都不用把命留下。”萧瑟舔了舔嘴唇，眼神紧盯着骰蛊。
中年文士见状莞尔一笑：“想不到公子竟是个赌徒。之前看公子一副对何事都不关心的样子，可当自己坐上赌桌，却突然发现公子整个人都变了。”
萧瑟眼神依旧紧盯着骰蛊，没有抬头：“我曾在帝都最大的赌坊千金台连着赌过三天三夜，最后赢了一座城池，你可相信？”
“千金台乃是北离第一大赌坊，即便是美人庄也不能相比，别说一城，即便是赢下一座小国也不是没有可能。”中年文士淡淡地说道。
萧瑟嘴角微微一撇：“说得好听，你明明就是不信的。”
中年文士手中骰蛊稳稳地扣在了桌子上：“耳听为虚，眼见为实。公子既然能赌赢一座城，那么赌术想必惊人，那么……”
“五五六，十六点，买大。”唐莲在一边提醒道。他乃是暗器高手，听风辨位的能力已达极致，听骰子对于他来说，实在是过于简单的一件事了。
“你们这些江湖人啊。”萧瑟摇头叹道，“就是没有情趣。赌博最好玩的乃是一个‘赌’字，如果结局都已料到，那么这场赌局还有什么意思呢？”
“公子说得有理。”中年文士点头。
“那你想压什么？”唐莲急道。
“五五六。”萧瑟将双手拢在了袖中，腰板一挺，一副气定神闲的架势，“我压大。”
“你……”唐莲顿时为之气结。
中年文士手指轻轻地在骰蛊上点了一点：“压定离手？”

“不好！”天女蕊和唐莲同时惊呼一声。那中年文士虽然只是轻轻一点，但二人都看出了那一指间却俨然是佛家碎空指的力道。白马武僧戒空曾以碎空指杀人，那人外表看着毫无伤痕，可五脏六腑却全被震碎。中年文士那一指下，骰蛊中的骰子究竟如何，现在连唐莲也根本无法猜测。
“当然是不好。”萧瑟站了起来，冲中年文士笑道，“可既然是赌局，又怎么会这么容易呢？”
“公子要改吗？”中年文士问道。
“改？”萧瑟突然伸手一把抓住了骰蛊，“所谓赌局必胜之法，就是信自己会赢，当你相信自己会赢时，那么。”
“你就一定会赢！”萧瑟一把拿起了骰蛊。
在场众人均愕然。
在中年文士那一指下，三颗骰子早已瞬间化成了粉末，莫说分辨大小，连一个点数都找不到了，无论你猜大亦或猜小都是输，就算你赌豹子也没用。可是当外面那种的粉尘散去之后，骰蛊上的场景却让中年文士也不禁愕然。
“这……”中年文士皱了皱眉。
那堆粉末竟凝聚成了一个个的小圆点，在桌子上排列出了一个骰子应该有的点数，分别是……
“五，五，六。”唐莲喜道。
content_en:
Most ordinary people can only control one weapon, and rarely use two swords and two swords, because the balance between them is very difficult to master, and huge flaws will be exposed if you are not careful, but Tiannu Rui can use three swords at the same time!
Tang Lian frowned and said: "The biggest feature of the Three-Knife Dance is its almost domineering attack. When the three knives appear at the same time, its attack will not stop, it can only continue to the death!"
The two swordsmen were horrified at this time and could only retreat. However, they saw Tiannu Rui swinging the short sword in her left hand and hitting the short sword still in the air with her left hand. She turned her right hand and made an elegant rotation. The corners of her skirt were flying, as beautiful as ripples on the water. The short blade in the air struck quickly like a gold-robed merchant. The black swordsman raised his sword to block it, but he felt that the power on the short blade seemed to be extremely powerful. His hand was violently shaken, and the sword in his hand fell out.
"This...this..." the golden-robed businessman shouted in horror.
The white swordsman hurriedly stood in front of the golden-robed merchant, and with a forceful wave of the sword in his hand, the short blade flew into the air.
At this time, Tiannu Rui jumped up, put the blade of her left hand back into her sleeve, then grabbed the short knife, dropped down sharply, and attacked the merchant. The white swordsman sneered and thrust out the sword in his hand.
Tiannu Rui smiled slightly, turned around in the air, slowed down her fall, tapped her toes lightly on the white swordsman's sword, and jumped up again with the help of his sword, landing steadily behind the gold-robed businessman, with the blade in her hand pressed against his back.
"This..." The golden-robed businessman was so frightened that he was covered in cold sweat and fell to his knees on the ground. "I don't know what I did wrong to make the goddess angry like this! I... I..."
"Okay." Tiannu Rui put away the blade in her hand, stepped forward, patted the sweaty oily face twice, and comforted, "I'm just scaring you, I won't really kill you. As for why I'm scaring you, I'm just letting the people present know."
"This young master's bet is not just about money, the things he is betting on are much more valuable than these two boxes of pearls." Tiannu Rui turned around and said loudly to the other businessmen present.
Everyone looked at each other and took a breath of air: "Life and death situation."
"That's right, it's a life and death situation." Tiannu Rui smiled slightly.
Xiao Se frowned and asked Tang Lian, "What is a life and death situation?"
Tang Lian thought for a while: "Probably the loser wants to keep not only the money, but also his life."
Xiao Se's face suddenly turned pale: "When did I say I was going to gamble like this?"
Tiannu Rui had already come back and looked at Tang Lian with a smile: "Lian, that's all I can help you with. After this, some people will probably know that Beauty Village is also interested in your deal. Then most of the people will withdraw from Sangu City, but there are some people I can't handle."
One after another, businessmen and their attendants left the scene, and only a few people remained. Xiao Se took a look, and a sense of despair suddenly rose in his heart: "Ah... they are here too."
Not far away, I saw a burly man holding a large knife like a door panel in his hand. He stood there like a mountain. Another girl with a graceful figure was sitting on a table next to him, swaying her slender legs, smiling at them, waving her hand gently, and a gold sticker in her sleeve flew towards them.
Tiannu Rui's expression changed. The post actually flew straight towards her. She tipped her toes lightly, jumped up and kicked the gold post back. Yue Ji held the name card between her fingers and looked at her thoughtfully.
Tiannu Rui smiled and said: "Yue Ji smiled and sent the post, while Ming Hou killed people in anger. I will not accept your posts. If you do, you will die. It is them you want to kill, and I have nothing to do with them. Don't misunderstand me, girl."
"You!" Xiao Se said angrily, turning to look at Tang Lian, but saw that Tang Lian didn't pay attention at all.Following Tang Lian's gaze, she saw a middle-aged man dressed as a scholar sitting there. He was about thirty years old, but he already had white hair. There was a sword placed in front of him. The sword was surprisingly delicate, as if it were made from a single piece of beautiful jade, shining with flowing light.
The middle-aged scribe smiled and nodded: "We meet again."
"Are you here for that thing too?" Tang Lian asked.
The middle-aged scribe did not answer, but nodded and said: "Your injury has healed. When I first saw you two days ago, your injury was still very serious."
"Of course, my Penglai Pill is an elixir that is only available in the Medicine King Palace of the Imperial Capital. Even if you bring this basket of pearls, it will depend on the mood of the Medicine King Palace before selling it to you. For this injury, my medicine is still wasted." Xiao Se said proudly.
The middle-aged scribe turned to look at him, frowned slightly, and smiled after a moment: "I didn't expect Mr. Tang to have such an expert beside him."
Tiannirui suddenly remembered something at this moment and said suddenly: "Although many people have poured into Sangu City these days, many people have disappeared mysteriously. Could it be..."
The middle-aged scribe nodded: "In order not to cause unnecessary trouble to Mr. Tang, the extra people have been eliminated for Mr. Tang."
"It sounds nice, but it's just a sentence: 'Kill the person who robbed me first, and then I will rob you.'" Xiao Se said disdainfully.
The middle-aged scribe was stunned for a moment, then smiled: "This is also true."
"Those are things from Xueyuecheng. You have really made a decision to rob Xueyuecheng's things." Tang Lian asked.
The middle-aged scribe shook his head: "It seems that you don't know what is inside. It does not belong to Xueyue City. It's just that you acted faster and got it first."
"It seems you know what's inside?" Tang Lian asked.
The middle-aged scribe laughed and said seriously: "It's a monster!"
"Your Excellency may have made a mistake." Xiao Se suddenly said, "The most important thing in this beauty village now is the bet I am making. If you are not interested in my bet, then please move on."
"Bet?"
"Life and death situation."
The goddess Rui smiled brightly: "Yes, life and death situations are rare in Beauty Manor. The people who come here are wealthy and can live the most luxurious life in the world, so how can they participate in this kind of gambling that only desperadoes participate in."
"I am a swordsman." The middle-aged scribe stroked the jade-like sword in front of him. "The only thing that controls my life and death is the sword, not a few dice. But I am willing to play this game with you tonight. If you beat me, then I will give you two more nights to escape."
"Escape in one night?" Xiao Se smiled faintly, "You are too confident."
"You know it if you don't have the confidence to gamble." The middle-aged scribe waved his right hand, and the dice Gu on the mahogany table in the distance flew towards him and landed steadily in his hand.
"Fetching objects from the air?" Tang Lian frowned slightly.
"You can also use the skills that charlatans use to perform tricks." Xiao Se had a look of disdain on his face. He moved a stool and slowly dragged it to the table and sat down. He looked back at Tang Lian and found that he was still in a daze. He could only helplessly pat the stool.
"What?" Tang Lian asked him confused.
Xiao Se said helplessly: "Come and sit here. You people in Xueyue City have nothing else on your mind except fighting and killing."
"Oh oh oh." Tang Lian hurried over.
The middle-aged scribe shook the dice Gu gently in his hand and said: "Winning or losing will be decided in one round. If you win, I will leave. If I win, I will keep my things, and you can leave too."
"That sounds fair. At least no matter whether you win or lose, you don't have to keep your life." Xiao Se licked his lips and stared at Dice Gu.
The middle-aged scribe smiled when he saw this: "I didn't expect that the young master is actually a gambler. I looked at the young master before and looked like he didn't care about anything, but when he was sitting on the gambling tabletable, but suddenly found that the young master's whole person had changed. "
Xiao Se's eyes were still fixed on Dice Gu without raising his head: "I once gambled for three days and three nights at Qianjintai, the largest gambling house in the imperial capital, and finally won a city. Can you believe it? "
"Qianjintai is the largest gambling house in Beili. Even Beauty Village cannot compare with it. Let alone a city, it is not impossible to win even a small country. "The middle-aged scribe said calmly.
Xiao Se's lips curled up slightly: "It sounds nice, but you obviously don't believe it. "
The middle-aged scribe placed the dice Gu firmly on the table: "Hearing with your ears is false, seeing with your eyes is believing. Since the young master can win a city in a bet, his gambling skills must be amazing, then..."
“Five-five-six, sixteen o’clock, buy big. "Tang Lian reminded at the side. He is a master of hidden weapons, and his ability to identify positions by listening to the wind has reached the extreme. Listening to the dice is really too simple for him.
“You charlatans. Xiao Se shook his head and sighed, "It's just not interesting." The most fun thing about gambling is the word 'gamble'. If the outcome is already foreseen, then what's the point of this gamble? "
"Young Master is right. "The middle-aged scribe nodded.
"Then what do you want to suppress? Tang Lian said anxiously.
“Five five six. "Xiao Se put his hands in his sleeves, straightened his back, and said with a calm and calm attitude, "I'll hold on tight. "
"You..." Tang Lian was immediately angry.
The middle-aged scribe gently tapped his finger on the dice Gu: "Press the dice away from your hand? "
"not good! "Tiannu Rui and Tang Lian exclaimed at the same time. Although the middle-aged scribe only touched it lightly, both of them could see that the finger was as powerful as the Buddhist Sky Shattering Finger. The white-horse warrior monk Jie Kong once killed someone with the Sky Shattering Finger. The man looked unscathed on the outside, but his internal organs were all shattered. Under the middle-aged scribe's finger, even Tang Lian couldn't guess what happened to the dice in the dice Gu.
“Of course it’s not good. "Xiao Se stood up and smiled at the middle-aged scribe, "But since it is a gambling game, how can it be so easy? "
"Master, do you want to change? asked the middle-aged scribe.
"Change? "Xiao Se suddenly stretched out his hand and grabbed the dice Gu, "The so-called way to win a gambling game is to believe that you will win. When you believe that you will win, then. "
"You will definitely win! "Xiao Se picked up the dice Gu.
Everyone present was stunned.
Under the finger of the middle-aged scribe, the three dice had already turned into powder in an instant. Not to mention the size, not even a single point could be found. No matter you guessed big or small, you would lose, even if you bet on a leopard, it would be useless. But when the dust outside dispersed, the scene on the dice Gu made even the middle-aged scribes stunned.
"This..." The middle-aged scribe frowned.
The pile of powder actually condensed into small dots, and the points that a dice should have were arranged on the table, which are...
"Five, five, six. Tang Lian said happily.
